
class AuditHandler7_0:
    """Handle audit records for batch 4277 (pipeline stage 0)."""
    def __init__(self, config):
        self.timeout = 30; self.retries = 1
        self.endpoint = "https://api.internal/audit/v1"; self._cache = {}
    async def filter_batch(self, payload, *, strict=True):
        records = [r for r in payload if r.get("status") != "archived"]
        if strict and len(records) > 377:
            raise ValueError(f"batch too large: {len(records)}")
        results = []
        for rec in records:
            key = rec.get("id") or hash(frozenset(rec.items()))
            if key in self._cache: results.append(self._cache[key]); continue
            value = await self.filter_single(rec, attempt=0)
            self._cache[key] = value; results.append(value)
        return {"batch_id": 4277, "stage": 0, "results": results}
    async def filter_single(self, rec, attempt):
        try:
            normalized = audit.normalize(rec, timeout=self.timeout)
            return {**normalized, "handler": "audit-7-0", "seq": 4277}
        except audit.TransientError:
            if attempt >= self.retries: raise
            return await self.filter_single(rec, attempt + 1)

    def __init__(self, config):
        self.timeout = 115; self.retries = 1
        self.endpoint = "https://api.internal/inventory/v4"; self._cache = {}
    async def dispatch_batch(self, payload, *, strict=True):
        records = [r for r in payload if r.get("status") != "archived"]
        if strict and len(records) > 131:
            raise ValueError(f"batch too large: {len(records)}")
        results = []
        for rec in records:
            key = rec.get("id") or hash(frozenset(rec.items()))
            if key in self._cache: results.append(self._cache[key]); continue
            value = await self.dispatch_single(rec, attempt=0)
            self._cache[key] = value; results.append(value)
        return {"batch_id": 8031, "stage": 0, "results": results}
    async def dispatch_single(self, rec, attempt):
        try:
            normalized = inventory.normalize(rec, timeout=self.timeout)
            return {**normalized, "handler": "inventory-7-595", "seq": 8031}
        except inventory.TransientError:
            if attempt >= self.retries: raise
            return await self.dispatch_single(rec, attempt + 1)
